launches.title: Prototyping.io - Autonomous Manufacturing for Mechanical Parts
launches.tagline: AI-driven manufacturing system that turns CAD designs into high-quality mechanical parts as fast as one day
launches.body:
# 

**TL;DR**\
[Prototyping.io](http://Prototyping.io) is rebuilding the design-to-manufacturing workflow from the ground up with an AI-driven approach, automating the path from CAD design to production at scale.

<https://youtu.be/q8G9q_MEzug>

**The Problem**\
Over $1T is spent annually on mechanical part manufacturing, yet the process remains largely manual.

Getting parts made still takes weeks, often with high costs and inconsistent quality. Manufacturers spend days on DFM, sourcing, programming, and setup planning before production even starts. These delays slow hardware companies down and stretch product iteration cycles.

Building locally is still expensive, largely due to fragmented operations and low machine utilization. Many companies look offshore for lower pricing, but shipping timelines, tariffs, and supply chain delays often slow product development even further.

**What We’re Building**

[Prototyping.io](http://Prototyping.io) is building autonomous manufacturing for mechanical parts by automating the workflow between CAD designs and finished parts.

The workflow today looks like:

CAD → DFM → Planning → Sourcing → Programming → Setups → Manufacturing Execution

This workflow is being rebuilt with AI-native systems and physical AI models for manufacturing.

Our approach combines AI-driven manufacturing intelligence, workflow automation, and eventually autonomous execution through industrial robotics and highly automated production systems. The goal is to dramatically reduce lead times, improve quality consistency, and enable more efficient manufacturing at scale.

**What We’re Seeing**

Demand for faster and more reliable manufacturing is growing across robotics, AI infrastructure, energy, automotive, defense, and other industries.

We’re already helping companies ranging from early-stage startups to multi-billion dollar enterprises reduce hardware iteration cycles from weeks to days by delivering high-quality parts for prototyping and early production.

**If This Resonates**

If you’re building hardware and want to move faster, we’d love to work with you.

If you’re interested in robotics, physical AI, manufacturing automation, or autonomous manufacturing and want to join the [Prototyping.io](http://Prototyping.io) team, we’d love to talk.
